title: Figure and sample-size code for "Should Clinical Foundation Models Reason Through Disease Labels? A Falsifiable Case for Diagnosis as an Interface"
description: Scripts that generate the schematic Figures 1 and 2 and Supplementary Figure S1, and the sample-size calculation with its simulation check, for the Viewpoint by Huang and Lu (JMIR Medical Informatics, manuscript 106804, under review). The figures are schematic and contain no measured data.
